verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing is an invoicing and billing service, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence only shows Stripe publishing its own MCP server for agents to call (server role, docs-21, probe-4), which does not make the client axis applicable. Nothing shows the product loading external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
